# botteams.io

> botteams.io is a public directory of company teams for Grok Bot, operated by Ellelion LLC. Not affiliated with xAI.

Ellelion LLC. Contact: info@ellelion.com
Source: https://github.com/ellelion/botteams
Canonical domain: https://botteams.io

## Guides

One query per URL. The definition stays on /grok-bot.

- [Grok Bot vs Claude Cowork](https://botteams.io/guides/grok-bot-vs-claude-cowork): Grok Bot is a named teammate on one account-scoped cloud computer. Claude Cowork is Anthropic's agentic workspace with local files and cloud sessions. Sourced 24 August 2026.
- [Grok Bot vs ChatGPT Work](https://botteams.io/guides/grok-bot-vs-chatgpt-work): Grok Bot is a named teammate on one shared cloud computer. ChatGPT Work is OpenAI's longer-task agent inside ChatGPT. Sourced 24 August 2026.
- [Grok Bot vs Cursor Cloud Agents](https://botteams.io/guides/grok-bot-vs-cursor-agents): Grok Bot signs into apps on one shared cloud computer. Cursor Cloud Agents clone a repo into an isolated VM and open a pull request. Sourced 24 August 2026.
- [Grok Bot vs Devin](https://botteams.io/guides/grok-bot-vs-devin): Grok Bot is a named teammate in your apps. Devin is Cognition's AI software engineer that writes, runs, and tests code. Sourced 24 August 2026.
- [Grok Bot vs Manus](https://botteams.io/guides/grok-bot-vs-manus): Grok Bot works inside your signed-in apps on one shared computer. Manus describes a cloud sandbox that returns finished files. Sourced 24 August 2026.
- [Grok Bot alternatives](https://botteams.io/guides/grok-bot-alternatives): A short chooser for Grok Bot, Claude Cowork, ChatGPT Work, Cursor Cloud Agents, Devin, and Manus. Each row links to a sourced 1:1 page. 24 August 2026.
- [How do you install a Grok Bot team?](https://botteams.io/guides/install-a-grok-bot-team): Copy one installer prompt from botteams.io, connect the connectors first, paste it into Grok Bot, and confirm each routine. Nothing installs on this site. 24 August 2026.
- [How do you create a Grok Bot?](https://botteams.io/guides/create-a-grok-bot): Create one Grok Bot from New chat, then edit its profile. Give it one job, a stop line, and a first task. 24 August 2026.
- [How do Grok Bot connectors work?](https://botteams.io/guides/grok-bot-connectors): Grok Bot connectors are account-wide. Every Bot can reach every connected tool. This directory lists 342 connectors. 24 August 2026.
- [How do Grok Bot skills and routines work?](https://botteams.io/guides/grok-bot-skills-and-routines): A skill is the written method. A routine is the schedule or event that runs it. Caps: 50 routines per Bot, 20 stored runs. 24 August 2026.
- [How do you write a Grok Bot profile?](https://botteams.io/guides/write-a-grok-bot-profile): Name, title, and description for a Grok Bot that stops before send, publish, or production. Uses this directory's approval pattern. 24 August 2026.
- [What is a Grok Bot group chat?](https://botteams.io/guides/grok-bot-group-chat): A Grok Bot team on this directory is two to six named Bots in one group chat, plus standing routines. Account cap: 50 Bots and group chats combined. 24 August 2026.
- [Who can use Grok Bot right now?](https://botteams.io/guides/who-can-use-grok-bot): Eligible plans on 24 August 2026: SuperGrok Plus, SuperGrok Heavy, Cursor Pro+, Cursor Ultra, and Cursor Teams Standard or Premium. No dollar figures. Cursor Pro without plus is absent.
- [How does Grok Bot security work?](https://botteams.io/guides/grok-bot-security): Grok Bot's cloud computer is account-scoped. A second Bot is not a vault. Deleting a Bot can leave files and sessions. Sourced 24 August 2026.
- [Can Grok Bot do SEO and AEO?](https://botteams.io/guides/grok-bot-for-seo): Grok Bot can draft SEO and AEO work that stops before publish. This directory has a Rank desk, a GEO/AEO desk, and an SEO/AEO Auditor. 30 August 2026.
- [What is a Grok Bot chief of staff?](https://botteams.io/guides/grok-bot-chief-of-staff): xAI's Chief of Staff use case is a source-linked digest of what changed. This directory's installer drafts only. It never sends mail or accepts a meeting. 24 August 2026.
- [Can Grok Bot do sales outbound?](https://botteams.io/guides/grok-bot-for-sales-outbound): xAI's Sales Outbound use case researches accounts and drafts outreach. This directory's installer never sends and never writes to the CRM. 24 August 2026.
- [Can Grok Bot help with recruiting?](https://botteams.io/guides/grok-bot-for-recruiting): xAI's Talent Scout use case sources candidates and drafts outreach. This directory's installer never contacts anyone. 24 August 2026.
- [Can Grok Bot manage an inbox?](https://botteams.io/guides/grok-bot-for-inbox): A Grok Bot can draft replies and a daily read-out. This directory's Inbox Manager never sends. Pair it with Chief of Staff if you want priorities, not just mail. 24 August 2026.
- [Can Grok Bot reproduce bugs?](https://botteams.io/guides/grok-bot-for-bug-reproduction): xAI's Bug Reproduction use case turns a report into a staging pack with steps and screenshots. It does not merge a fix. 24 August 2026.

## Teams

A team is two to six Bots in one group chat.

- [Accounts payable](https://botteams.io/teams/bookkeeping-ap): Watches what the company owes: bills in, duplicates caught, and nothing paid twice or paid late by accident.
- [Company team](https://botteams.io/teams/company): Six Bots run a solo company week.
- [Editorial standards](https://botteams.io/teams/content-editorial): Reads drafts before a human editor does, catching claims without sources, house-style breaks, and the things that get fixed at the last minute.
- [GEO / AEO desk team](https://botteams.io/teams/content-geo-aeo): Treats generative answers as a citation problem.
- [Rank desk](https://botteams.io/teams/content-rank-desk): Reads Search Console and DataForSEO once a week, names what moved, and writes the next fix instead of another dashboard.
- [Release desk](https://botteams.io/teams/engineering-release): Answers what actually shipped, what it changed, and whether anything got worse afterwards.
- [Founder OS](https://botteams.io/teams/founder-os): Money, inbox, and a chief of staff in one founder room.
- [Interview scorecards](https://botteams.io/teams/hiring-scorecards): Keeps hiring decisions evidence-based by chasing the scorecard while the interview is still fresh.
- [Indie distribution team](https://botteams.io/teams/indie-distribution): Turns a real release into the public notes a human posts.
- [Paid media desk](https://botteams.io/teams/marketing-paid-media): Reads live spend and creative, recommends the next reallocation and the next test, then waits.
- [Discovery desk](https://botteams.io/teams/product-discovery): Keeps product decisions attached to evidence, and says plainly when there is none.
- [Outreach desk](https://botteams.io/teams/recruiting-outreach): Writes outreach that names the person's actual work, and stops the sequence the moment someone replies.
- [Outbound desk](https://botteams.io/teams/sales-outbound): Runs outbound where the research is real and the sequence stops the moment someone answers.
- [Support during incidents](https://botteams.io/teams/support-incident): Handles the support side of an outage: one accurate message, updated, instead of forty different answers.
- [X growth team](https://botteams.io/teams/x-growth): Drafts X posts, reads the replies, and proposes the next test.

## Bots

A bot is one Bot doing one job. No group chat.

- [Applicant sheet screen](https://botteams.io/bots/applicant-sheet-screen): Scores a row from a sheet or Ashby against a written bar and drafts the next mail. Never rejects anyone.
- [Customer Pulse Briefing Bot](https://botteams.io/bots/customer-pulse-briefing-bot): Reads Gmail and Slack every weekday at 09:00, drafts a Notion priority queue, and only replies after approval.
- [New-hire 30-60-90](https://botteams.io/bots/new-hire-ramp): Turns a role into a 30-60-90 plan on the calendar, with check-ins drafted and access left to a human.
- [On-page SEO fixer](https://botteams.io/bots/on-page-seo-fixer): Finds the decaying page, drafts titles, meta, and internal links, and opens a change for review. Never publishes.
- [Account Health](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-account-health): Reads usage and support signals across the book and hands back a watch list before the quarterly review, not after it.
- [Account Manager](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-account-manager): Rebuilds the context for every account call so nobody walks in cold, and leaves the follow-up drafted.
- [Account Research Specialist](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-account-research-specialist): Tiers accounts before anyone touches them, with the evidence attached to each score.
- [Apartment Scout](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-apartment-scout): Watches listings against your rules and lines up tours, without committing you to anything.
- [Beta Adoption Watcher](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-beta-adoption-watcher): Says who is actually using the new feature, so the follow-up goes to real users.
- [Bug Reproduction](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-bug-reproduction): Turns a vague report into a repro report an engineer can trust: steps, screenshots, what the network did.
- [Calendar Coordinator](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-calendar-coordinator): Chases the interview holds nobody else has time to chase.
- [Call FAQ Miner](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-call-faq-miner): Turns the questions people actually ask on calls into answers with a timestamp and a source.
- [Chief of Staff](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-chief-of-staff): Reads the week across mail, calendar and chat and tells you what moved, what matters, and what to do about it.
- [Cloud Agent Orchestrator](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-cloud-agent-orchestrator): Keeps many agent runs moving and reports only what is stuck.
- [Community Operations Manager](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-community-operations-manager): Keeps the ambassador loop moving so community work is not a full-time chase.
- [Compelling Events Monitor](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-compelling-events-monitor): Watches for a real reason to reach out, then drafts the reach-out.
- [Competitive Intelligence Analyst](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-competitive-intelligence-analyst): Reports the shifts that actually gained traction, with a link for every claim.
- [Contract Desk](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-contract-desk): Shows the week of paper at a glance and flags what is stuck.
- [CRM Operations Manager](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-crm-operations-manager): Keeps the pipeline clean without a manual pass after every meeting.
- [Daily Briefing Writer](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-daily-briefing-writer): A short morning brief of the things that actually matter to you, each with its source.
- [Deal Desk Coordinator](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-deal-desk-coordinator): Writes the internal deal note from what already happened, ready for you to submit.
- [Deck Updater](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-deck-updater): Updates the deck from the notes while the call is still fresh.
- [Docs Auditor](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-docs-auditor): Finds the docs that stopped being true and drafts the rewrite.
- [Enablement Fulfillment Specialist](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-enablement-fulfillment-specialist): Answers a request for recordings and one-pagers without anyone digging.
- [Event Guest Screener](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-event-guest-screener): Scores event applicants against your profile so the room fills with the right people.
- [Executive Assistant](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-executive-assistant): Keeps you oriented without living in channels, including a catch-up when you join a new thread.
- [Expense Manager](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-expense-manager): Builds the weekly money summary and chases the missing categories before review.
- [Feature Request Tracker](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-feature-request-tracker): Keeps the trail of who asked for what, so a spec has real demand behind it.
- [Hiring Screener](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-hiring-screener): Scores applications against a written bar so the interviews go to the strongest.
- [Inbox Manager](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-inbox-manager): Triages the inbox into something usable and drafts the replies.
- [Internal Communications Manager](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-internal-communications-manager): Drafts internal copy in the house voice, matched to the audience.
- [Invoice Coordinator](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-invoice-coordinator): Stops invoices sitting, and names the human who needs to act.
- [LinkedIn Campaign Manager](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-linkedin-campaign-manager): Keeps the lead-gen funnel consistent across ads, forms, follow-up and tracking.
- [Marketing Calendar Owner](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-marketing-calendar-owner): Keeps the content, launch and events calendars in sync without a weekly chase.
- [Meeting Prep Buddy](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-meeting-prep-buddy): Builds the prep sheet so nobody walks into a meeting cold.
- [Merch Fulfillment Operator](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-merch-fulfillment-operator): Runs the merch loop and asks you before anything ships.
- [Newsletter Writer](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-newsletter-writer): Writes the monthly issue from what actually shipped, parked for one edit.
- [Onboarding Manager](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-onboarding-manager): Gives a new starter a path instead of a pile of links.
- [Paid Media Creative Strategist](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-paid-media-creative-strategist): Spots the creative that is working early and says why, without inventing numbers.
- [Paid Media](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-paid-media): Reads live channel data and recommends a reallocation, then waits for you.
- [Personal Site Builder](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-personal-site-builder): Scaffolds a personal site and untangles the domain, leaving you a live starting point.
- [Pipeline Analyst](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-pipeline-analyst): Scrubs the pipeline and drops a Monday scoreboard with the risks named.
- [Playtest Operator](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-playtest-operator): Drives the real interface when an API will not do, and reports what broke.
- [Presentation Designer](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-presentation-designer): Builds an on-brand deck from the template instead of a blank slide.
- [Product Feedback Analyst](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-product-feedback-analyst): Clusters scattered feedback into a prioritised view with the evidence attached.
- [Product Performance](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-product-performance): Walks the dashboards and comes back with hotspots and a short writeup.
- [Prospecting Plan Builder](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-prospecting-plan-builder): Builds the week of outbound so it starts from a list, not a blank page.
- [Prototype Builder](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-prototype-builder): Turns an ask into something clickable, with a screenshot and a link.
- [Renewal Desk Operator](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-renewal-desk-operator): Briefs every renewal 90 days out and only escalates when terms are stuck.
- [Sales Call Coach](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-sales-call-coach): Leaves timestamped coaching on the call, plus a score.
- [Sales Outbound](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-sales-outbound): Researches accounts overnight and leaves a drafted, reviewable outbound list.
- [Security Questionnaire Filler](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-security-questionnaire-filler): Drafts every field of a vendor questionnaire from what you have already answered.
- [SEO / AEO Auditor](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-seo-aeo-auditor): Tracks keyword, technical and AI-answer movement in one place, with a plan attached.
- [Social Media Manager](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-social-media-manager): Drafts in your voice when something worth posting ships, and parks it.
- [Status Report Writer](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-status-report-writer): Pulls open action items out of docs, meetings and chat into one living list.
- [Subscription Cleaner](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-subscription-cleaner): Finds the subscriptions you forgot about and cancels only what you approve.
- [Talent Scout](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-talent-scout): Runs sourcing to scheduling overnight and stops at every point of contact.
- [Ticket Triage Specialist](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-ticket-triage-specialist): Watches the support queue on a cadence, drafts replies, and stays quiet when it is clean.
- [Travel Coordinator](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-travel-coordinator): Compares options against your rules and confirms with you before anything is booked.
- [Vendor Portal Operator](https://botteams.io/bots/xai-vendor-portal-operator): Works the portals that have no clean API and reports exceptions only.
